action: Dewater and purge export gas pipelines; purge process systems; start LQ emergency DG for power; start LQ air compressor
Start 1 GTG on diesel mode; start CPP air compressor
Open 1st AQWA well to test separator; pressurize AQWA process; drain completion liquid to sea
Route gas and liquid to CPP; pressurize CPP and flare tower; route liquid to liquid separation system
Route gas to gas system and start fuel gas system (purging/blanket gas, fuel gas, chemical system)
Open 2nd AQWA well to test; switch 1st well out of test
Switch GTG to fuel gas; start 2nd GTG on fuel gas; start glycol regeneration and hot oil systems in cold circulation
Open 3rd AQWA well; switch 2nd well out of test and 3rd well to test
Open 4th–7th wells on AQWA, then 8th well and re-open other wells
Start GTC in circulation mode; start WHRU to heat hot oil and glycol regeneration
Start dew point system (JT valve); open MRU bypass; switch dew point from JT valve to expander unit if needed
Start MRU; close bypass line when gas dew point is on spec
Export gas to export gas pipeline
Condensate to stabilizer in circulation (VRU recycle at turndown), export to FSO when on spec; produced water injected into AQWA wells if on spec, off-spec to FSO
